Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 98: July 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #98 shipped to subscribers in June 2009 (bearing the cover date of July 2009 for Issue 98). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #98 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, unlockable content, and exclusive E3 previews:

Madden NFL 10 (sports simulation)
Tiger Woods PGA Tour 10 (golf simulation)
Summer Athletics 2009 (sports simulation)
Battlefield 1943 (Xbox Live Arcade multiplayer FPS)
"Splosion Man (Xbox Live Arcade action platformer)
Droplitz (Xbox Live Arcade puzzle game)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring major E3 2009 coverage including Project Natal (Kinect), Halo: Reach, Modern Warfare 2, and Forza Motorsport 3, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
